## Goal

Identify three small, well-scoped tasks suitable for new contributors (docs typos, fixture coverage, CLI help clarity) and label them `good first issue`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] At least three open issues labelled `good first issue`
- [ ] Each issue has clear reproduction / acceptance criteria
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md points newcomers at the label filter
